notes: Neumann official KH 80 DSP A G page (the anthracite variant; the white KH 80 DSP A W is listed by Neumann as a colour variant and its page was not read). Free-field response 57 Hz–21 kHz (±3 dB) is stored; 53 Hz–21 kHz (±6 dB) and 61 Hz–20 kHz (±1.25 dB pass band) are also published. Amplifiers: 120 W woofer + 70 W tweeter at 10% THD+N with limiter deactivated (stored 190 W is that sum); 90 W + 50 W at 0.1% THD+N. Drivers: 100 mm (4 in) woofer + 25 mm (1 in) tweeter; crossover 1.8 kHz, 48 dB/oct; front-ported; 233 x 154 x 194 mm; 3.5 kg; max SPL 108.8 dB (half space, 3% THD). Active monitor: no sensitivity or speaker impedance is published (the 14 kOhm figure is analog input impedance, not a speaker rating). Horizontal and vertical directivity are published only as plot images on the page; no data file was imported.

Neumann official KH 420 (KH 420 G) page. Free-field response 26 Hz–22 kHz (±3 dB) is stored; 25 Hz–22 kHz (±6 dB) and 28 Hz–20 kHz (±2 dB pass band) are also published. Three-way tri-amplified: the page text states Class AB amplifiers of 330 W and two times 140 W (the data table lists woofer 330 W and tweeter 140 W at 10% THD+N, limiter deactivated); the stored 610 W is 330 + 140 + 140. Drivers: 265 mm (10 in) woofer, fabric-dome midrange (size not published), 25 mm (1 in) tweeter; crossover 570 Hz and 2.0 kHz; front-ported; 645 x 330 x 444 mm; 35.0 kg; max SPL 122.4 dB (half space, 3% THD). Active monitor: no sensitivity or speaker impedance published. Directivity is published only as plot images (both cabinet orientations); no data file imported.

Neumann official KH 750 DSP (KH 750 DSP D G) page. Free-field response 18 Hz–750 Hz (±3 dB) is stored; 16–800 Hz (±6 dB) is also published. Amplifier: 256 W at 10% THD+N with limiter deactivated. Single 265 mm (10 in) driver in a sealed cabinet; fixed 80 Hz, 4th-order crossover for its bass-managed output; 383 x 330 x 383 mm; 19.5 kg; bass-capability max SPL 105.0 dB (half space, 3% THD, 50–100 Hz). Active subwoofer: no sensitivity or speaker impedance published (the >13 kOhm figure is analog input impedance).
